morning2_start.name: {name}
morning2_start.text: *Day two. The uniform feels a bit more comfortable than yesterday. — My steps feel lighter, too.*

morning2_greet_seo_1_roof.name: Seoyeon
morning2_greet_seo_1_roof.text: What you said on the roof yesterday — still stands?

morning2_greet_seo_1_gate.name: Seoyeon
morning2_greet_seo_1_gate.text: What you said at the gate yesterday — you remember, right?

morning2_greet_seo_2.name: {name}
morning2_greet_seo_2.text: *Seoyeon approached first. The clipboard is pressed against the inside of her arm again today. Dain glances from the back of the classroom and turns away. Yuna turns her pages faster.*

morning2_greet_seo_others_2.name: {name}
morning2_greet_seo_others_2.text: *Two subtle reactions. — Should I notice, or pretend I didn't?*

morning2_greet_dain_1.name: Dain
morning2_greet_dain_1.text: Hey! Yesterday was fun, let's hang again today!

morning2_greet_dain_others_yuna.name: {name}
morning2_greet_dain_others_yuna.text: *Can't tell if it's sarcasm or admiration. Yuna doesn't react. But the hand writing a note has stopped.*

morning2_greet_dain_others_2.name: {name}
morning2_greet_dain_others_2.text: *I laughed it off, but the sound of the clipboard being tapped came to mind a beat later.*

morning2_greet_yuna_1.name: {name}
morning2_greet_yuna_1.text: *About to sit down — a folded note on my desk. '...Thank you for yesterday.'*

morning2_greet_yuna_2.name: {name}
morning2_greet_yuna_2.text: *Yuna's handwriting. One sentence longer than yesterday. — On the back, in tiny letters: 'Library annex at lunch.'*

morning2_greet_yuna_others.name: Seoyeon
morning2_greet_yuna_others.text: A letter this early in the morning?

morning2_greet_yuna_others_seo.name: {name}
morning2_greet_yuna_others_seo.text: *She's smiling. But her eyes stop on the note.*

morning2_greet_yuna_others_2.name: {name}
morning2_greet_yuna_others_2.text: *I fold the note and hold it in my hand. The crease presses into my palm.*

morning2_dain_1.name: {name}
morning2_dain_1.text: *The moment I open the classroom door — something slams into my back.*

morning2_dain_3.name: Dain
morning2_dain_3.text: Haha, that knocked you over?! You need to work out!

morning2_dain_4.name: {name}
morning2_dain_4.text: Isn't it a little early for this much energy?

morning2_dain_5.name: Dain
morning2_dain_5.text: This IS normal! You're the one running on empty!

morning2_dain_6.name: Dain
morning2_dain_6.text: *Her voice fills the classroom before morning homeroom even starts.*

morning2_note_1.name: {name}
morning2_note_1.text: *I'm about to sit down when — I spot a folded note on my desk.*

morning2_note_2.name: {name}
morning2_note_2.text: *'Come to the library annex at lunch. — Yuna'*

morning2_note_3.name: {name}
morning2_note_3.text: *Same neat handwriting as yesterday. Short. And the location is specific. — The library 'annex'? That's a different place from yesterday.*

morning2_seo_1.name: Seoyeon
morning2_seo_1.text: *Passing through the hallway, glancing into the classroom* Sleep well last night?

morning2_seo_4.name: {name}
morning2_seo_4.text: The council president walks all the way to the classroom just to say hi?

morning2_seo_5.name: Seoyeon
morning2_seo_5.text: It's patrol. — And an attendance check.

morning2_minsu_1.name: Seoyeon
morning2_minsu_1.text: *Just before her turns the corner, her steps slow. The clipboard presses closer against her arm.*

morning2_minsu_1b.name: {name}
morning2_minsu_1b.text: *I'm staring at the hallway where Seoyeon disappeared — when Minsu turns around behind me.*

morning2_minsu_3.name: Minsu
morning2_minsu_3.text: Dude. Two days in and the council president comes to say hi to YOU? I've been here a year and she won't even look my way.

morning2_dain_claim_2.name: Minsu
morning2_dain_claim_2.text: ...That's true, but that's not the point.

morning2_dain_claim_4.name: Dain
morning2_dain_claim_4.text: Even the student council president's interested in our transfer kid? Someone's popular!

morning2_dain_claim_6.name: Dain
morning2_dain_claim_6.text: I saw you first — so yeah, OURS. Dibs.

morning2_break_transition.name: {name}
morning2_break_transition.text: *Break time. Stepped out into the hallway.*

morning2_break_transition_b.name: {name}
morning2_break_transition_b.text: *The homeroom teacher is standing by the classroom door. Holding the attendance sheet, she glances over — and our eyes meet.*

morning2_break_1.name: {name}
morning2_break_1.text: *The end of Seoyeon’s clipboard touches the desk. I missed the right time to say no.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_1.text: Oh, {name}. Come to the faculty office for a sec.

hidden_homeroom_d2_1_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_1_c.text: No, just checking your transfer paperwork. — Administrative stuff.

hidden_homeroom_d2_2_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_2_b.text: *I followed the homeroom teacher to the staff room. A drawer at a corner desk is slightly open. Beneath a pile of papers, the edge of manuscript paper shows through.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_3.text: Looked at your old transcript. Your literature grades were solid. You into reading?

hidden_homeroom_d2_3_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_3_c.text: *The teacher's gaze lingers for a moment on the open drawer.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_3_d.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_3_d.text: You like reading. What about writing?

hidden_homeroom_d2_3_e.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_3_e.text: *The finger resting on the report card covers the corner of the manuscript paper.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_3_g.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_3_g.text: *The teacher's gaze flicks toward the drawer, then comes right back.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice1.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice1.text: *The gaze toward the drawer still remains. I decided not to ask any more questions about report cards.*
choices: What about you? What do you read?

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice1_a.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice1_a.text: *pausing briefly* ...Mystery novels. Not the whodunit kind — the ones that trace the motive.

hidden_homeroom_d2_6.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_6.text: *The edge of the manuscript is visible through the slightly open drawer. The homeroom teacher puts down the coffee cup and pushes the drawer closed.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_7.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_7.text: How's the adjustment? Better than yesterday?

hidden_homeroom_d2_7_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_7_b.text: A lot better. I like the people in my class.

hidden_homeroom_d2_8.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_8.text: Dain's loud, isn't she? — She's always like that. But there's a difference between a kid making trouble and a kid with too much energy.

hidden_homeroom_d2_8_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_8_b.text: Dain must be pretty well-known if even you've noticed her.

hidden_homeroom_d2_8_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_8_c.text: 'Well-known' isn't quite the word... *takes a sip of coffee* More like — someone I worry about.

hidden_homeroom_d2_8_d.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_8_d.text: *The teacher's eyes pause for a moment on the row with Dain's name tag.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_8_e.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_8_e.text: *Setting down her coffee* ...Anyway. Nothing out of the ordinary on your end.

hidden_homeroom_d2_8_f.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_8_f.text: *The homeroom teacher covers her mouth with the coffee cup and turns the saucer twice in the same spot.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_10.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_10.text: It's part of the job. Homeroom duties.

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2.text: *She says it's work, but there's still a smile in her eyes.*
choices: For 'just work,' you look pretty happy about it.
Thanks for looking out for me.

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2_a.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2_a.text: *Hides behind her coffee cup* ...Poker face failed. Fine. Get out of here.

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2_b.text: *waving hand* Oh, stop. That's embarrassing. ...Go on, get out of here.

hidden_homeroom_d2_11.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_11.text: ...If I treat the transfer kid too well, the others'll talk.

hidden_homeroom_d2_11_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_11_b.text: *The teacher's voice sinks low into the inside of the coffee cup.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_12.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_12.text: *Leaving the faculty office — I can't stop thinking about those papers in the drawer.*

morning2_seo_dust_1.name: {name}
morning2_seo_dust_1.text: *Break time after 1st period. I pass by Seoyeon in the hallway. Seoyeon stops and looks at my shoulder. The hand holding the clipboard comes up first.*

morning2_seo_dust_3.name: Seoyeon
morning2_seo_dust_3.text: *Her hand touches {name}'s shoulder. There is no hesitation in the motion as she brushes off the dust.*

morning2_dain_react_1.name: {name}
morning2_dain_react_1.text: *The touch on my shoulder registers a beat too late. — Probably not because of the dust.*

morning2_dain_react_2.name: {name}
morning2_dain_react_2.text: *Seoyeon walks away like nothing happened. Dain's voice comes from behind.*

morning2_dain_react_3.name: Dain
morning2_dain_react_3.text: WAIT! What was that?! Did she just touch your shoulder?!

morning2_dain_react_5.name: Dain
morning2_dain_react_5.text: Dust... was there actually dust though?!

morning2_dain_react_6.name: {name}
morning2_dain_react_6.text: *Instead of answering, I adjust my bag strap. Dain sees it but doesn't ask further.*

morning2_end.name: {name}
morning2_end.text: *The girl who never approached anyone first in a whole year — came up to me first.*
